cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 600 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import planner, controller, stress2
rng=random.Random(7)
per=[rng.choice([1,4,8,16]) for _ in range(8)]
case=stress2.big_case(rng,S=256,J=512,F=8,G=32,per=per)
out=controller.run(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode())
res=out['results'][0]
m=planner.Model(case,res['predictions'],res['thresholds'])
m.pairs=planner.eligible_pairs(m)
lo,hi,_=m.scan_coverage()
print('pairs',len(m.pairs),'r*',m.rset[lo],'r+',m.rset[hi] if hi<len(m.rset) else None)
wp=m.wants(m.rset[hi]); arcs=planner.arc_list(m,m.pairs,wp)
t=time.time(); adj=planner._direct_residual(m,wp,arcs); nodes=planner._reachable(adj,m.K,m.K); t1=time.time()-t
print('direct fallback %.2fs nodes=%d holds=%s'%(t1,len(nodes),planner.cut_holds(arcs,wp,nodes)))
t=time.time(); ok=planner.cut_holds(arcs,wp,res['cut']); print('projected holds',ok,'check %.3fs'%(time.time()-t))
PYEOF
